title: News Words: Immense
source: VOA Learning English (미국 정부 제작물 - 퍼블릭 도메인). 원문: https://learningenglish.voanews.com/a/7963046.html

sentences.text: Welcome to the Voice of America's Newswords.
A ceasefire between Israel and Hamas took effect in mid -January.
Part one of the ceasefire is 42 days long.
It suspends a war that began in 2023 after Hamas attacked Israel and Israel responded in Hamas -led Gaza.
After the ceasefire, displaced Gazans returned to their homes to find immense destruction.
Immense describes something very large in size or amount.
An ocean can be described as an immense body of water.
